summary: TAP Real Estate Technologies, Inc. filed an 8-K to report entry into an Amended and Restated License Agreement with TAP, Inc. on June 29, 2026, converting a prior term license into a perpetual, royalty-free license for blockchain and tokenization technology in the real estate sector. The license fee is $700,000, of which $695,000 has been paid, with the remaining $5,000 due by September 30, 2026. No special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring occurred. This is a routine licensing agreement disclosure. No deal terms, premium, or shareholder vote are involved. The filing reflects a standard contractual update falling outside special-situations categories.
